dct_title_s: British Columbia, Shuswap sheet : economic minerals and glacial striae / by George M. Dawson, assisted by James McEvoy, 1898 compiled and drawn by James McEvoy.
dct_description_sm: Covers an area in southeastern British Columbia. Most of the area covered is in the Regional District of North Okanagan; the area includes Adams Lake, Shuswap Lake, Salmon Arm, Enderby, Armstrong, and Vernon.; Relief shown by contours, shading, and spot heights. Depths shown by soundings.; Also shows roads, trails, and Indian villages.; Includes inset of the northern portion of Adams Lake.; "Sheet No. 11"--Upper margin.; "669"--Lower right margin.
1 map : col. 54 x 51 cm., on sheet 67 x 92 cm
